querySelection: Smallest SHA256(seed|language|split|subset|qid), capped by availability; official dev/test splits remain intact.
corpusSelection: All judged documents for selected dev/test queries, including explicit negatives, plus smallest SHA256(seed|language|docid) background IDs from deterministic hash-ordered official corpus shards; read enough whole shards to cover the largest requested size. Judged passage versions win ID conflicts. Nested backgrounds, identical corpora across methods. This is judgment-augmented bounded-shard sampling, not an official full-corpus MIRACL score.
analysisLanguage: Known monolingual benchmark split language for every candidate; this tests lexical analysis, not detection or mixed-language routing.

ranking.tieBreak: document SHA256 ordering via deterministic rowid

querySemantics: Unquoted analyzed terms are unique OR clauses; AND requires all unique clauses; MSM60 requires ceil(0.6 * unique clauses). Quoted full inputs use one phrase. No stopword filtering. Current baseline keeps existing mark-dropping sanitizer. Original lane uses the prototype's segmented NFKC/lowercase surfaces.
exactTier: Full original analyzed phrase, then all original terms, then remaining stem-OR; within each tier stem-OR rank then document hash. Union phrase/AND/stem candidates, each at fusion input depth.
primaryComparison: Each OR candidate versus current-porter-or on relevant test queries, macro averaged across 18 languages; also report each language and query-paired bootstrap intervals. Other modes are predefined secondary comparisons.

uncertainty.unit: query within each language; equal-weight language macro; resampling seed is policy seed + metric + comparison + size

abstention.scope: language, method, and corpus size independently
abstention.objective: balanced accuracy for relevant versus no-known-positive query subsets
abstention.tieBreak: lower no-known-positive acceptance, then higher threshold
abstention.score: top result's negated BM25, RRF score, or lexicographic exact tier plus reciprocal stem rank
abstention.caveat: No-known-positive queries have no relevant passage among their original judged candidates; added background is unjudged and may contain relevant passages. Apparent false acceptance is not a universal irrelevance claim.

reportPrivacy: Commit aggregate metrics, public query IDs, hashes, configuration and timings only. No query or corpus text, local paths, secrets, or machine details.
freeze: Written before any extended-public retrieval scores were computed. No parameter selection on held-out test results. Corrections require an explicit policy version and disclosure.
